A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SceneSplat and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete supplementary material. Appendix relocations and renumbering can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original Gaussian reconstruction, zero-shot and supervised segmentation, ablation, and cross-domain classification results in the main text and supplement.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and reports revised dataset statistics and multi-source segmentation results.

M1.justification: The language-label collection algorithm, encoder-decoder architecture, vision-language losses, and GaussianSSL components remain unchanged. The architecture section is relocated, without changing its configurations.

E1.justification: Within Table 2's multi-source vision-language experiment, Matterport3D joins ScanNet and ScanNet++ as a training source. Matterport3D already appeared elsewhere in the work; evaluation benchmarks and tasks, including appendix object classification, remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains OpenScene, PLA, RegionPLC, OV3D, and Mosaic3D. The Point Transformer comparisons, Occam's LGS runtime comparison, and appendix ScanNet20 comparator set also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Table 2's training-data multiplier changes from 1.75 to 2.92, and Table 1 revises per-source scene counts. The local-crop maximum changes from 256,000 in v1 Table H to 102,400 in v2 Table C, matching the existing Appendix A.4 description. Metrics and training schedules remain unchanged; these revisions do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The loss, input-representation, nearest-neighbor, reconstruction-quality, autoencoder, masking, and cross-domain analyses are retained. Appendix tables and qualitative examples are relocated rather than newly added.

E5.justification: Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Figure 5 retains the same scene-level distribution boxplots.

E6.justification: Central dataset statistics change substantially: Table 1 reports 11.27 rather than 8.15 billion Gaussians and average PSNR 29.64 rather than 28.17 dB. Table 2 replaces two-source f-mIoUs of 19.3/12.6/29.1 with three-source results of 21.4/13.8/28.4 on ScanNet200/Matterport3D/ScanNet++; these are different training conditions. Other numerical experiment tables remain unchanged. Appendix B.2 newly calls MGM best on ModelNet10, although the retained results rank MGM+LA first.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(15), including feature weighting, training losses, and coding-rate regularization, retain the same mathematical content. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion revise the claimed dataset contribution from 6,868 to 7,916 scenes. The principal novelty, feed-forward recognition, self-supervised learning, and state-of-the-art segmentation claims remain the same.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning noisy language supervision, temporal inconsistency, reconstruction quality, and cross-domain semantic mismatch are retained. The stated limitations concerning source imagery, annotations, and label consistency remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: Reported H100 memory changes from 80 to 94 GB, and dataset construction resources change from 119 to 150 L4 GPU-days, alongside revised storage estimates. The supplement revises 3RScan and Matterport3D licensing descriptions and adds original-team hosting as a distribution option. The code link and prospective release status remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. Bibliographic differences concern citation back-references following appendix relocation, rather than added or removed research.

P1.justification: V2 copyedits prose, corrects cross-references, revises an author affiliation, adds acknowledgments, and shortens the impact statement. Architecture Designs moves from Appendix D to A.7; the overall scientific narrative remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1's dataset inset is updated. Architecture and augmentation tables move from v1 Tables F-H to v2 Tables A-C, with experimental tables correspondingly renumbered and reflowed. Table formatting and some captions change, while the remaining figure content is retained.

improvement.justification: V2 resolves the local-crop inconsistency and improves organization and cross-references. However, updated results introduce reporting inconsistencies: Table 2's caption still describes two sources and an 11.1-point ScanNet++ advantage, Appendix C.2 retains the old PSNR, and Appendix B.2 misidentifies the ModelNet10 winner. The headline scores also use expanded training data. These clarity gains and reporting regressions leave the net quality change uncertain.
